gold_review.explanation: build_dataset calls random.shuffle(all_tasks) with the unseeded global RNG, so each load serves a different first-5 subset and only 2/5 gold requests matched. Where gold did reach the env it scored well above garbage (0.73/0.47 vs ~0.17), so the grader responds to correctness; side issue is a non-reproducible eval set.
